mapper.sql:
FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = ( SELECT mm2.id FROM member_memberships mm2 WHERE mm2.member_id = m.id AND mm2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm2.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm2.end_date ASC, mm2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id
LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.id = ( SELECT ta2.id FROM trainer_assignments ta2 WHERE ta2.member_id = m.id AND ta2.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ta2.started_at DESC, ta2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(checked_in_at) AS last_attendance_at FROM attendances GROUP BY member_id ) latest_attendance ON latest_attendance.member_id = m.id
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR lc.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') )
AND m.status = #{condition.status}
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND mm.id IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.name, lc.login_id, m.phone, m.status, mp.name AS membership_name, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days, t.name AS trainer_name, latest_attendance.last_attendance_at
ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{page.size} OFFSET #{page.offset}

SELECT m.id, m.name, lc.login_id, m.phone, m.birth_date, m.joined_at, m.status, u.last_login_at FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{memberId}

SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mp.name AS membership_name, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, GREATEST(DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS remaining_days, LEAST( 100, GREATEST( 0, ROUND( DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, mm.start_date) / GREATEST(DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, mm.start_date), 1) * 100 ) ) ) AS usage_percent, mm.status FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = #{memberId} AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm.end_date ASC, mm.id DESC LIMIT 1
